name: webui-manager
description: A self-hosted Flask app for organizing and launching your internal web services. Stores service URLs grouped by host with optional credentials, category tags, and auto-discovered favicons.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your UTC TZ offset for database timestamp recording. List of available TZs: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones

variables.name: DB_HOST
variables.description: Your MariaDB/MySQL database host or container name

variables.name: DB_USER
variables.description: The designated user for this application in the database. For more info on the requirements, please visit: https://github.com/nullata/webui-manager/blob/main/README.md#database-setup

variables.name: DB_NAME
variables.description: Your MariaDB/MySQL database name. For more info on the requirements, please visit: https://github.com/nullata/webui-manager/blob/main/README.md#database-setup

variables.name: DB_PARAMS
variables.description: Additional database connection string parameters. Make sure to set a value for charset matching your database. Default: ?charset=utf8mb4

variables.name: SECRET_KEY
variables.description: Flask session secret. Required for multi-replica deployments. Leave blank for auto-generated per restart.

variables.name: APP_CREDENTIALS_KEY
variables.description: Key used to encrypt stored credentials at rest. Leave blank for auto-generated per restart.

variables.name: SESSION_COOKIE_NAME
variables.description: Name of the session cookie. Only change this if you run several copies of WebUI Manager on the same hostname and want each to keep its own login. Default: webui_manager_session

variables.name: AUTO_MIGRATE
variables.description: Run automatic schema migration on startup. Default: true
